title: Georgia judge blocks own order to turn over US election ballot copies to state board
summary_full: Superior court judge Kelly Lee Ellerbe paused the order after county election officials filed a notice of appealA judge in Fulton county, Georgia, has blocked her own order to turn over electronic copies of 2020 election ballots seized by the FBI in a raid to the Georgia state election board.Superior court judge Kelly Lee Ellerbe paused the order after county election officials filed a notice of appeal.
